response.changelog:
What's New in Pixel OS v2.1.17:
• Restored Qualcomm SLPI Sensor Engine & Real-Time Adaptive Brightness: Fixed vendor.sensors.sscrpcd.rc so /vendor/bin/sscrpcd starts Qualcomm SLPI FastRPC and registers stk_stk2x3x ambient light and all motion/proximity sensors, combined with multihal ALS hysteresis/rate-limit fixes, persistent per-room user brightness pattern learning across PhysicalMappingStrategy updates, and unified QS & Settings slider learning.
• Strict Home-Screen-Only Double-Tap Lock: Double-tap to lock triggers exclusively on the unlocked Home Screen wallpaper and is strictly blocked while typing (keyboard open), inside any app, on the status bar, or on the lock screen.
• Fixed Goodix G3 Optical UDFPS Scanning & Enrollment (20-Tap Ready): Locked Saturated/Unmanaged linear color output during optical finger-down capture, synced notify_fppress HBM pulse ordering in HWC/DRM + samurai_hw_daemon queued commands, and preserved fp_enable across screen-off/screen-on cycles.
• Calibrated Dark-Room Minimum Brightness & 15s Screen Timeout: 2.0-nit to 450-nit 10-bit Samsung AMOLED curve and reliable 15-second screen-off sleep even while USB-plugged.
• Fixed Banking & UPI Apps (Paytm, PhonePe & Google Pay) & Duplicate Camera App Icon alongside built-in KernelSU-Next v1.0.9.
• 60fps Google Pixel OLED Boot Animation & Wi-Fi Hotspot Stability.
